findings: OST14–16 use precision-one correction and completeness of the coefficient ring to prove finite generation and the reverse value-filtration inclusion; no finite freeness or completeness of the ordinary submodule is presumed.
OST17 obtains projectivity from the actual evaluation/section splitting after a Noetherian Hopfian argument, then finite freeness over the local ring; the argument does not require reducedness.
OST18–20 use actual finite generation and the monoid factorization to prove ordinary invertibility without excluding the small residue primes.
OST22 establishes residual reconstruction over B using the same A-sections and finitely many factorial-limit congruences, without presuming projector base change.
OST23 must state A-linearity of v_p and B-linearity of vprime_p. This was reported to the author and is now explicit; the application uses actual linear evaluation maps.
